title: Actions upon reception of the MIB
text: Upon receiving the MIB the UE shall:
1 > if the UE is in RRC_IDLE or in RRC_INACTIVE, or if the UE is in RRC_CONNECTED while T311 is running:
2 >  if the cellBarred in the acquired MIB is set to barred:
3 >  if the UE is a RedCap UE:
4 >  if ssb-SubcarrierOffset indicates SIB1 is transmitted in the cell (TS 38.213 )
5 >  acquire the SIB1, which is scheduled as specified in TS 38.213 ;
3 >  consider the cell as barred in accordance with TS 38.304 ;
3 >  perform cell re-selection to other cells on the same frequency as the barred cell as specified in TS 38.304
